_comment: Hand-written Spanish that outranks the DeepL output for the same key, applied by `npm run i18n:translate`. Use this for terms of art the machine gets wrong: `residual` is a trust condition left unresolved, not `residuo` (rubbish); `envelope` is the signed `sobre`; `issuer`/`verifier` stay `emisor`/`verificador`. Keys not listed here keep the machine translation.
_comment.autonyms: Language names stay in their own language in every catalogue — a switcher that renders `English` as `Ingles` is unreadable to the person who most needs it, someone stranded in a language they do not speak looking for the way back.
_comment.quietZone: DeepL rendered `quiet zone` as `zona de silencio` in the label and `zona de seguridad` in the note — one concept, two names, in two strings shown next to each other. `Zona de silencio` is the established Spanish term for the blank margin around a QR.
lab.scenario.artifactQuietZone.note: La carga útil firmada es válida, pero el código QR impreso se generó sin su zona de silencio, por lo que la inspección del artefacto señala un indicador visual de manipulación.
_comment.gate: `Gate` here is a check that decides pass or fail, not a floodgate — `compuerta` reads as plumbing.
_comment.cameraReady: `Camera ready` is the camera's state, not the printing idiom `camera-ready` that DeepL reached for (`Listo para su publicación`). The sibling states are `Cámara inactiva` and `Cámara activa`, so this one matches them.
lab.camera.ready.title: Cámara lista
_comment.historyCase: `{source}` is substituted mid-sentence, so what follows it stays lowercase — DeepL capitalised `Aceptado` but not `bloqueado`, splitting one pair of labels into two styles.
lab.scenario.expired.note: El verificador debe rechazar este sobre en la comprobación de la ventana temporal.
about.body.verdicts: Los veredictos mantienen visibles esos residuales en lugar de redondearlos a verde: el esmeralda significa aceptado, el rojo significa rechazado o manipulado, y el ámbar significa restringido por política o degradado en tiempo de ejecución. Un veredicto ámbar nunca es un resultado positivo: es el verificador indicándole exactamente qué cuestión de confianza sigue abierta.
_comment.recordVerb: `Record X` on a submit button is the imperative verb, but with no sentence around it DeepL read it as the noun `registro` and produced label-shaped noun phrases: `Clave de confianza del registro` means `registry trust key`, not `Record trust key`. Every button below is restored to `Registrar …`. The three that DeepL already got right (`issuerStatus`, `policyStatus`, `natsSubscriber`) are left alone.
operator.workflow.authority.submit: Registrar la configuración de la autoridad
operator.workflow.runtimeProvider.submit: Registrar el proveedor de tiempo de ejecución
operator.workflow.outboxRemediation.subm: Registrar la corrección de la bandeja de salida
_comment.recording: The in-flight state of those same buttons. `Grabando` is recording audio or video; this is writing a governance record, so it tracks `Registrar`.
_comment.workflowFields: Terse form labels with no sentence to disambiguate them. `Domain` is a DNS domain (`Dominio`), not the abstract `Ámbito` — which is already `scope` two fields away. `Subjects` are NATS subjects; the sibling hint string says `Patrones de asunto`, so the label matches it rather than reading as Kafka `Temas`. `Proof method` is the method of proving control (`prueba`, matching `Referencia de la prueba`), which DeepL collapsed into `verificación` — the word the adjacent `Verification status` field already owns.
_comment.behaviorFields: `Stale behavior` is what the verifier does *when* a verdict is stale. `Comportamiento obsoleto` says the behaviour itself is obsolete, and `Comportamiento no disponible` says there is no behaviour available — both invert the meaning.
_comment.workflowResults: Result banners built around wire values. DeepL dropped the copula after `{subject}`, capitalised `Ahora` mid-sentence, rendered `attempts {attempts}` as `inténtelo en {attempts}` (`try it in N`), lost the `subject rule` noun entirely, and called hosts `servidores` while the form label next to it says `Hosts permitidos`.
operator.workflow.queued: {subject} está {status}; {event} se ha puesto en cola.
operator.workflow.queuedNow: {subject} ahora está {status}; {event} se ha puesto en cola.
operator.workflow.subscriberRules: {subject} está {status}; se han aprobado {count} regla(s) de asunto.
